id./param/scenario/cs/b_160_cs_040.pack|cs_:
"An immense evil radiates from up ahead...
  Surely, beyond here...

"Mordegon...
  The time to settle this has come at last.
  Let's go, {var:1}.
"Hey! What is this!?
"I... I can't move...!

"Ha ha ha ha! You were fooled!
  Did you think Jasper would end like that!?

"We beat them already, didn't we!?
  Don't tell me they came back!?

"Heh heh... It was always going to end thus.
  Hendrik! You cannot defeat me!

"{var:1}! If you want to reach our lord,
  go alone! But in exchange,
  I'll be taking these ones' lives!
"He won't be alone...

"I am {var:1}'s shield!
  I won't leave my lord, the sword, alone!

"Don't underestimate us, Jasper!
  We won't bow to your
  underhanded tricks anymore!

"This power can't stop us!
  We'll beat you, go to Mordegon,
  and settle our debt from sixteen years ago!

"I swore it to my sister!
  That I'd protect {var:1} to the very end!

"We won't let you go alone, {var:1}!
  I want to see it too!
"The Luminary's miracle that slays the Lord!

"I... I can still fight...
  Lord Mordegon, lend me your power once more...
"Jasper... Let's end this.

"No... I can't die yet...
  Hendrik... until I surpass you, I...

"...Jasper.
  You said you wanted to be me.

"But ever since the king took me in,
  I've been chasing your back.
"You... were my light...

"I am who I am because of you.
  Jasper, why can't you see that...
"H-Hendrik...

Hendrik picked up Jasper's pendant
from the ground and clutched
it tightly!

"...Let's go.
  To Mordegon, the source of all this ruin.
